wine.name: CrossOver 26.3.0 sources (LGPL)
wine.note: Same tarball as highball-engine's inputs.json, and the one the working engine was built from.

llvm-mingw.name: llvm-mingw 20260908 (UCRT, macOS universal)
llvm-mingw.note: Compiler of the PE half of the working engine. Highball uses mingw-w64 gcc (llvm-mingw broke Steam's login); not shown to matter for the Store edition.

deps.note: x86_64 run-time libraries built by engine/build-deps.sh, replacing the copies from CrossOver.app's lib64.

sdl2.note: Controllers: Wine's winebus.sys reads every pad SDL knows (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, 8BitDo, generic HID) and maps it to an XInput layout.

configureNote: The working engine's flags. FreeType and GnuTLS are off for configure and turned on afterwards in config.h with bare library names (as tools/mac_enable_freetype.sh and tools/mac_enable_gnutls.sh did), so Wine dlopens the x86_64 copies engine/build-deps.sh puts in the engine's lib/. SDL2 is handled the same way (SONAME_LIBSDL2, headers on make's command line). --enable-archs comes from the variant: the Steam variant adds the 32-bit half, which Steam's installer and client need (they are 32-bit programs).

dxmt.name: DXMT, Highball's build 331c552 (MIT)
dxmt.source: https://github.com/gauthierpiarrette/dxmt (fork of 3Shain/dxmt), commit 331c552, built by highball-engine's build-dxmt.yml
dxmt.note: Steam variant only: the renderer Steam's own window draws with. Steam's web views cannot present under D3DMetal (black window; Highball's SteamRestart.swift). DXMT's release builds refuse a swap chain for another process's window ('CreateSwapChain: cross-process swapchain not supported yet'), which is how Steam's GPU process draws; Highball's fork allows it behind DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, with engine patch 0011 on the Mac driver's side. Measured 2026-11-07 on an M5 Pro, macOS 27.2: v0.80 logs that error, this build draws Steam's sign-in window.

mingw-w64.name: mingw-w64 gcc (Homebrew, brew install mingw-w64)
mingw-w64.note: Steam variant only: the PE half and its 32-bit side, as Highball builds it. highball-engine/inputs.json: llvm-mingw is known to break Steam's login (frankea, 2026-08-04).
